SELECT
    account_id,
    COALESCE(account_label, account_id) AS account_label,
    balance_gbp,
    interest_rate_pct,
    is_current_account
FROM money.balances
WHERE updated_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY balance_gbp DESC;

-- Did the monthly investment transfer actually happen?
-- We look for any outgoing payment in the last 40 days whose description
-- looks like an investment platform. Adjust the keyword list to match
-- whichever provider you actually use.
SELECT
    COUNT(*)                     AS transfer_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(booked_at), '1970-01-01'::date) AS last_transfer_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount_gbp)), 0)            AS total_invested_gbp
FROM money.transactions
WHERE amount_gbp < 0
  AND booked_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '40 days'
  AND (
        raw_description ILIKE '%vanguard%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%invest%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%isa%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%hargreaves%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%fidelity%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%aj bell%'
     OR raw_description ILIKE '%interactive investor%'
  );
